title: add downgrade guard + backup/restore and rollback tooling for private-installer (helm/terraform)
author: Clara Huang
description: Motivation: upgrades of private deployments have caused a small number of customer incidents where a version mismatch or failed migration left clusters in a partially-migrated state. This PR adds a downgrade guard and integrated backup/restore + rollback helpers to the private-installer and associated Helm/Terraform modules to make upgrades safe and reversible. Summary of changes: 1) installer: add 'upgrade-precheck' and 'pre-upgrade-backup' hooks that run as Kubernetes Jobs; these capture Postgres logical backups (pg_dump) and etcd snapshots (when present) to a configured object store (S3/GCS) before applying migrations. 2) downgrade guard: runtime-level check that prevents applying a release with a lower semantic version unless --force-downgrade is set; the guard validates the operator, schema version in DB, and assets checksum. 3) schema migrations: add idempotent up/down migration scripts for the main Postgres schema and a migration runner that records applied migration IDs in a migrations table; include a safe 'down' path for the last N migrations. 4) rollback tooling: add 'redwood-installer rollback' subcommand that downloads the latest pre-upgrade backup, restores DB to the pre-upgrade snapshot, rolls back helm releases (where supported) and re-applies compatible manifests. 5) terraform: expose a new 'backup_bucket' module input and add lifecycle hooks to enable pre-upgrade snapshots for infra-managed clusters. 6) helm charts: add pre-upgrade and post-upgrade hooks, tests, and a 'migration-check' Job template; charts are version-pinned to avoid accidental cross-version upgrades. 7) docs: new runbook in docs/private-installer/upgrade-rollback.md and example commands for common rollback scenarios. Checklist: - [x] pre-upgrade backup job + object store integration - [x] downgrade guard implementation + CLI flag - [x] idempotent up/down migrations + migration table - [x] rollback command + restore flow - [x] helm hook templates and chart version pinning - [x] terraform input + docs updated - [x] unit + integration tests (helm hooks + migration runner) Testing: added unit tests for migration runner and CLI flag parsing, and an integration CI workflow that deploys a minikube cluster, runs pre-upgrade backup, applies a migration, and then uses the rollback command to restore the original state. CI showed transient failures on the first run due to RBAC for the backup job; fixed by scoping serviceaccount permissions and re-ran the workflow (green). Backwards compatibility: default behavior is no-op for installs that don't enable the backup_bucket config; existing clusters aren't affected until the operator/cluster-admin opts in. Rollback gating: the downgrade guard will block downgrades unless --force-downgrade is explicitly passed and an operator acknowledgement is provided in the CLI (safety). Related: links to Linear items ENG-2987 and ENG-3041. Impact: reduces upgrade blur window and provides an automated, tested rollback path for Private deployments. Merge: squash-merged to main.
commits: Add pre-upgrade backup job and object-store helpers
Implement downgrade guard and CLI --force-downgrade flag
Add migration runner with up/down scripts and migration table
Add rollback subcommand and restore flow
Expose backup_bucket input in terraform module
Add helm pre/post upgrade hooks and version pinning
Tests: unit tests for migration runner and integration e2e workflow
review_comments: Marco Silva: Can we make the pre-upgrade backup Job configurable to use either pg_dump or pg_basebackup? It helps for bigger DBs. Reply: We added an option 'backup_mode' with values 'logical' (pg_dump) and 'physical' (pg_basebackup) and documented tradeoffs.

Evelyn Cho: Migration rollback safety: limit automatic 'down' to last 2 migrations and require explicit confirmation to run deeper rollbacks. Reply: Implemented limit and added an --allow-deep-rollback flag that requires interactive confirmation or a confirmed token in automation.
Samir Patel: CI flakes were due to RBAC; can you scope the SA to only the backup/restore verbs? Reply: Narrowed the service account RBAC and updated tests — CI green on rerun.
release_notes: Private-installer: added pre-upgrade backup hooks and object-store integration (S3/GCS)
Private-installer: downgrade guard prevents accidental downgrades; use --force-downgrade to override
Installer: new 'rollback' command to restore DB and helm releases to pre-upgrade state
Helm charts: pre/post-upgrade hooks and migration-check job templates
Terraform: new backup_bucket input to enable managed pre-upgrade snapshots
Docs: upgrade/rollback runbook with examples and operator checklist
